AssertAction.description: A first-class checkpoint step: the predicate must hold on the current screen, else the run stops.
AssertAction.title: AssertAction

Branch.description: Where a step may lead: continue with the next step, or end with a declared business outcome.
Branch.title: Branch

FieldSpec.description:
A typed capability input or output.

Values cross the boundary as strings: decimals are exact decimal strings ("75.37"), dates ISO 8601. `pattern`
is a full-match regex for inputs and string outputs.
FieldSpec.title: FieldSpec

Fingerprint.description: Record-time facts about the target. Any non-primary strategy hit must agree on these hard fields.
Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

Outcome.description: A declared business outcome: a legitimate answer for the caller, not a failure.
Outcome.title: Outcome

Provenance.description: Where the capability came from. Hashed with the body: re-recording is a change that needs re-approval.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Strategy.description:
One way to find a target, surface-agnostic. Ranked: role, same_row, table_cell, scoped, css.

Names are stored as observed and matched normalized-exact (anchored, case-insensitive, whitespace-folded,
icon glyphs dropped, optional trailing ':'/'*'), never as substrings (spike S7). String fields may reference an
input as `${name}`; the resolver substitutes the value before searching.
Strategy.title: Strategy

Target.description: An element a step acts on or reads. `strategies[0]` is primary; the rest are ranked fallbacks.
Target.title: Target

Fingerprint.description: Record-time facts about the target. Any non-primary strategy hit must agree on these hard fields.
Fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

Handler.description:
A budgeted recovery for a content-positive state. Effect none only: it runs the login flow or clicks one
dismiss control, then re-classifies or restarts from the entry (only while retry-safe).
Handler.title: Handler

LoginForm.description: The scripted login: credentials come from the run's settings, never from an artifact or a model.
LoginForm.title: LoginForm

Meaning.description: What a state means when it appears and the step did not branch on it.
Meaning.title: Meaning

RoutePattern.description:
A request that commits: method, path glob, required query parameters and required form fields (each a glob;
`*` is the only wildcard). Dolibarr validation commits are GET requests with a CSRF token while the payment is a
POST whose action is in the body, so path and query alone cannot identify every commit. Parameters or fields not
listed are ignored. See `cua.artifact.routes.is_commit`.
RoutePattern.title: RoutePattern

State.description:
A classified screen. The signature reads screen content (static predicates only): the login form appears at
any URL after a session is lost, so URLs alone never identify a state.

A state that `specializes` another is that state plus its own signature (child wins when both match); any other
overlap between matching states is ambiguous and fails closed.
State.title: State
